#4415: the signed shipping validator
[dxv]       <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe
[dxil.dll]  <repo>/build/tools/clang/test/dxc_releases/v1.8.2505.1/dxc_2025_07_14/bin/x64/dxil.dll
[dxil.dll]  FileVersion | ProductVersion | Company = 1.8.2505.32 | 1.8.2505.32 (b106a961d) | Microsoft(r) Corporation
[note] this dxil.dll comes from the v1.8.2505.1 release archive, not from this working tree; nothing here builds it.

==== WITNESS: is the external validator actually being used? ====
# zeroinit.ll asks for validator version 1.10. The internal validator in this
# tree accepts that; the older signed dxil.dll cannot. A version
# complaint here is proof the environment variable took effect.
$ set DXC_DXIL_DLL_PATH=<repo>/build/tools/clang/test/dxc_releases/v1.8.2505.1/dxc_2025_07_14/bin/x64/dxil.dll
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe zeroinit.ll
  error: Validator version in metadata (1.10) is not supported; maximum: (1.9).
  Validation failed.
  [exit] 1 -> REJECTED

[WITNESS-OK] the signed dxil.dll is answering, not the internal validator.

==== CONTROL: same invalid handle on a checked opcode ====
# Must be REJECTED. If the signed validator accepted this too, the 
# subject's acceptance would say nothing about annotateHandle.
$ set DXC_DXIL_DLL_PATH=<repo>/build/tools/clang/test/dxc_releases/v1.8.2505.1/dxc_2025_07_14/bin/x64/dxil.dll
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe release-modules\v1.8.2505.1-checkedop-zeroinit.ll
  Function: main: error: Instructions should not read uninitialized value.
  note: at '%3 = call %dx.types.ResRet.f32 @dx.op.textureLoad.f32(i32 66, %dx.types.Handle zeroinitializer, i32 0, i32 0, i32 0, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef)' in block '#0' of function 'main'.
  error: Resource handle should returned by createHandle.
  Function: main: error: load can only run on UAV/SRV resource.
  note: at '%3 = call %dx.types.ResRet.f32 @dx.op.textureLoad.f32(i32 66, %dx.types.Handle zeroinitializer, i32 0, i32 0, i32 0, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef)' in block '#0' of function 'main'.
  Function: main: error: texture load only works on Texture1D/1DArray/2D/2DArray/3D/MS2D/MS2DArray.
  note: at '%3 = call %dx.types.ResRet.f32 @dx.op.textureLoad.f32(i32 66, %dx.types.Handle zeroinitializer, i32 0, i32 0, i32 0, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef, i32 undef)' in block '#0' of function 'main'.
  Validation failed.
  [exit] 1 -> REJECTED

==== SUBJECT: annotateHandle with a zeroinitializer handle ====
$ set DXC_DXIL_DLL_PATH=<repo>/build/tools/clang/test/dxc_releases/v1.8.2505.1/dxc_2025_07_14/bin/x64/dxil.dll
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxv.exe release-modules\v1.8.2505.1-zeroinit.ll
  Validation succeeded.
  [exit] 0 -> ACCEPTED

==== verdict ====
  witness  : external signed validator engaged
  control  : textureLoad + zeroinitializer -> REJECTED
  subject  : annotateHandle + zeroinitializer -> ACCEPTED

  The signed shipping validator applies the uninitialized-handle rule
  to textureLoad and not to annotateHandle. #4415 is about that gap.
